invariants: One per-slug self_service_ai_proofs document permanently binds phase, original workspace incarnation and verified owner. It is not a day/month budget; midnight or policy version/expiry edits do not replenish it.

After binding, absent selector/policy, malformed config, expired policy, changed owner/incarnation, unsupported marker or different phase cannot silently fall back to normal transport. New starts fail and allowance projects unavailable. A bound ledger is retained through cleanup.

Normal unselected tenant quotas and existing sales/practice/legacy model behavior are preserved. A strict proof-state read is required to distinguish an unbound workspace from uncertain/missing authority; storage failure is not treated as an empty binding.

Trusted logical receipt comes only from server admission. Browser-provided proof fields are not used. Existing daily tenant/shared logical limits also remain in force; failed proof admission may conservatively consume daily allowance without inference.

The installed SDK receives a context-bound custom fetch through existing makeClient/runAgent. Every direct SDK attempt, including retry, reserves immediately before transport. Lost/timeout responses retain debit; no completed-message usage total substitutes for physical reservations.

Only HTTPS POST api.anthropic.com/v1/messages (optional unique beta=true query), approved model, stream and bounded tokens/body are allowed. Redirects are forbidden. Proof mode omits/rejects server-side fallback options/beta; provider-internal processing cannot be counted or assigned another effective model by this proof.

Ordinary record tool calls reserve one name/input/contact-bound stable operation before actual bookVisit/flagLead. Same operation returns one record; changed kind/payload/contact cannot create a second record. Ordinary request remains unmarked so real owner delivery can be proved.

A validated website setup sample has its own finite persistent slot and uses its existing websiteActionId/websiteSetupCheck marker. It neither consumes ordinary slot nor becomes owner-delivery evidence. Private rehearsal remains simulated while every real model transport is counted.

Proof tool rejection is supplied back to the model. It can still produce a completed final answer; acceptance therefore checks retained record and tool error, not a false assumption that every rejected tool forces an HTTP failure.

No model requests, emails or service activation are authorized by this implementation. Separate managed-owner-email policy still bounds sends; no implicit phone, text, Calendar, Stripe, purchase, publication or external-site authority.
